$comment: Third-party files copied into plugins. Each copy is the upstream file at `commit` plus our attribution header (lines starting with '# From <name>' or '# Adapted for' right after the shebang). Check drift with `mkt vendor`; pull a reviewed update with `mkt vendor update [--to <sha>]`. A `fork` entry is our modified copy: it is reported, never overwritten.

files.fork: layered-context guards: Inputs heading by prefix, #section stripped, 'Do NOT load' skipped, inputs outside runs/ strict, ROOT = cwd; candidates to offer upstream
reads sources from raw/ at the bundle root, skips _archive/, accepts only .md/.txt; offered upstream
